annotation.title_clean: 貨物利用運送事業法施行規則
annotation.title_en: Enforcement Regulations of the Freight Forwarding Business Act
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (formerly Ministry of Transport), Japan
annotation.summary_en: Japanese ministerial ordinance implementing the Freight Forwarding Business Act, setting registration, permit, filing and notification procedures for freight forwarders. Only incidental embodied-AI content: applicants using automated freight vehicles (自動運行貨物運送) must submit operating-condition documents and Road Traffic Act permit prospects.
key_provisions_or_claims: Registration procedures and financial threshold (3 million yen) for Type I freight forwarders
Permit and business plan requirements for Type II operators, including collection/delivery fleets
Applicants for automated freight operation must submit automated driving device operating conditions (Road Traffic Act/Road Vehicles Act references)
Specific automated operation applicants must submit Road Traffic Act permit application copies
Delegation of authority to regional transport bureaus and public disclosure on websites
